stem: Different canopy positions show different maturity indicators. What harvest-sampling plan is strongest?
choices: Sample predefined representative positions across plants and canopy zones using the same observation method
Sample only the easiest flower to reach
Use one photograph from the previous crop
rationale: A representative, repeatable sampling plan reduces bias when maturity varies spatially.
